skill.description: Capture conversations, decisions, and notes as structured Notion pages for wiki entries, how-tos, FAQs, and decision logs.
skill.summary: Turns conversations, decisions, and notes into structured Notion knowledge pages.

security_audit.summary: The static external command findings are Markdown inline references and setup commands, not executable code in the skill. The Notion MCP URL is an expected integration endpoint and does not show exfiltration or malicious intent. No semantic prompt injection or hidden instructions were found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Label these commands as manual setup steps and require explicit user approval before running them.

remediation.issue: The skill depends on a remote Notion MCP endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to verify the mcp.notion.com domain before OAuth login and before adding the MCP server.

content.value_statement: Important decisions and notes often stay buried in chat. This skill turns conversations into structured Notion pages with links, owners, and follow-up context.
actual_capabilities: Clarifies whether content should become a decision, how-to, FAQ, wiki entry, learning note, or documentation page.
Searches and fetches existing Notion pages before creating or updating linked content.
Creates Notion pages with database properties, titles, tags, owners, dates, and relations.
Updates existing Notion pages and links them to hub pages, related docs, and teams.
Extracts facts, actions, rationale, prerequisites, edge cases, and concise answers from conversations.
limitations: Requires a working Notion MCP connection and OAuth login.
Does not include packaged database schema files in the scanned skill directory.
Needs user confirmation when multiple Notion databases could match the request.
Depends on user-provided context for accuracy and freshness.

use_cases.title: Record Product Decisions
use_cases.description: Turn planning discussions into decision pages with rationale, alternatives, owners, dates, and related records.

use_cases.title: Build Support FAQs
use_cases.description: Convert repeated customer questions into concise Notion FAQ pages with clear answers and links to deeper documentation.

use_cases.title: Maintain Engineering Docs
use_cases.description: Capture technical conversations as how-to guides, documentation updates, and linked knowledge pages for future reuse.

prompt_templates.title: Capture a Decision
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one decision page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Capture this conversation as a Notion decision page. Include the decision, rationale, alternatives, owner, date, tags, and related links.

prompt_templates.title: Create a How-To Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for reusable operational guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these notes into a Notion how-to page. Include prerequisites, steps, expected outcome, edge cases, owner, and useful source links.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Chat Into FAQ
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for support or team knowledge.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this conversation into a Notion FAQ. Write clear questions, concise answers, tags, owner, and links to related documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Update and Link Knowledge
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that may update existing pages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Notion for related pages, update the best match, or create a new page. Add backlinks, relations, status, owner, and a short changelog.

output_examples.input: A team chat decides to keep the current billing provider after reviewing two migration options.
output_examples.output: A Notion decision page with summary, chosen option, rejected alternatives, rationale, owner, review date, tags, and links to billing docs.

output_examples.input: Support notes describe how to reset a workspace integration after an OAuth token expires.
output_examples.output: A Notion how-to page with prerequisites, reset steps, expected result, troubleshooting notes, owner, and related FAQ links.

output_examples.input: A long onboarding conversation includes repeated questions from new engineers.
output_examples.output: A Notion FAQ page with grouped questions, short answers, source links, tags, and links to deeper onboarding documentation.

best_practices: Confirm the target database, audience, and page type before creating content.
Search Notion first so updates link to existing pages instead of creating duplicates.
Capture owners, status, dates, relations, and source links for future maintenance.
anti_patterns: Do not create pages from unclear conversations without asking for missing context.
Do not store sensitive personal or customer data unless the workspace policy allows it.
Do not skip backlinks, tags, or owners when the page must remain discoverable.

faq.question: Does this skill create Notion pages automatically?
faq.answer: It can create or update pages through Notion MCP after the user connects and authorizes Notion access.

faq.question: Can it update existing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow tells the assistant to search and fetch existing pages before updating or linking content.

faq.question: What types of knowledge does it support?
faq.answer: It supports decisions, how-to guides, FAQs, wiki entries, learning notes, and documentation pages.

faq.question: Does it include Notion database templates?
faq.answer: The skill references template guides, but the scanned package only contains SKILL.md.

faq.question: Is Notion OAuth required?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup flow uses Notion MCP login before the assistant can access the workspace.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
